interpretation: Near the probe baseline supports a local low-resistance route; a beep alone is insufficient. Record finite resistance without rounding it to a short. A changing reading may involve capacitors. None of the proposed pairs is new measured evidence.

next_stages.work: Finish the R23 feedback branch, J3 signal route and receiver output; RF excitation and one complete antenna tuning cell follow. Then check the smaller C6, D6, C26, TP9, R41 and D1 endpoints. U3 pin5 DC return and J3 ground ordering are now established. Use photos and earlier via results before each small batch.

instructions: Use H (J3 pin 2) for B08-B09, then L (U3 pin 6) for B10-B11. Finally measure E (R22 right end) to G (GND TP). These are proposed checks; none assumes a short. All letter labels from the previous batch keep their meanings.
result_summary: U3 pin 5 and R22 D/left join VREF at about 1 ohm; E/right is 10 kohm away. J3 pin 3 is GND at 1 ohm; pin 2 reads 290 kohm to ground. Both R23 ends read 270-289 kohm to the VREF input, so the old R23-to-VREF connection is removed. R23 and J3 pin 2 still need their actual destinations established.
